email_note: A public email (Numberone@tnopaintinghandyman.com) is listed on the business's Facebook About section (found via WebSearch). However the domain tnopaintinghandyman.com does NOT resolve: confirmed NXDOMAIN via python socket.gethostbyname, and independently via Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) and Google (8.8.8.8) DNS-over-HTTPS lookups (both returned Status 3 / NXDOMAIN for A, MX and NS records). Since the domain is not registered, this email would bounce and is not usable as a live contact channel. Left null per the no-invented/no-broken-contact rule.
address_note: Google Maps live listing shows '445 Kensington View Dr, Winter Haven, FL 33880' as the registered/principal address (residential, no public storefront). Florida Sunbiz filing (per WebSearch summary of city-data.com) separately lists a mailing address of '1162 Old South Drive, Lakeland, FL 33811', confirming a genuine Lakeland connection consistent with the assigned slug and how the business is found/served (Thumbtack profile is filed under 'Lakeland, FL'). Given the residential principal address and no public storefront, the site presents this as a service-area business (Lakeland, Winter Haven & Polk County) with no street address shown on-page, consistent with the pipeline's variant for service-area trades with no public location. JSON-LD address uses addressLocality 'Lakeland' only (no streetAddress).

hours_note: Google Maps live listing returned only one day fragment ('Friday, 9 AM to 7:30 PM') across multiple fetch attempts; not a reliable full-week schedule, so no hours are shown on the site (no invented schedule).
rating_source: Rating 4.7 independently confirmed LIVE on Google Maps via scripts/gmaps_detail.js and scripts/gmaps_verify.js (run 3+ times, consistent 4.7 every time, visible in rawSnippet). The review COUNT of 39 was the figure already surfaced in discovery for this exact listing and could not be independently re-extracted from Google Maps' signed-out panel in this session (the panel's limited view did not expose a review-count element to the scraper, only the star rating). Cross-referenced against third-party aggregators for plausibility: nears.me summary cites '4.7-star rating from 37 customer reviews' (close, same ballpark, different snapshot date); Birdeye (reviews.birdeye.com) shows a separate blended figure of 4.8/48-49 reviews across multiple platforms (Google + others); Angi/HomeAdvisor show a different blended 4.4 rating. 39 was used as the Google-specific figure per the task brief.
own_site_check: Google Maps live: website field is null / 'Add website' shown (confirmed 3x via gmaps_detail.js and gmaps_verify.js, hasWebsiteButton: false in gmaps_discover.js). A domain, tnopaintinghandyman.com, is referenced by third-party aggregators (WebSearch summary citing an old directory description) and appears in the business's own Facebook contact email, but the domain does NOT resolve: curl returned connection failures (HTTP 000) for http/https on both tnopaintinghandyman.com and www.tnopaintinghandyman.com, python socket.gethostbyname raised 'Name or service not known', and independent DNS-over-HTTPS lookups against Cloudflare (1.1.1.1) and Google (8.8.8.8) both returned Status 3 (NXDOMAIN) for A, MX and NS records. The domain is not registered/active. BBB profile explicitly lists no website. Treated as has_own_site: false (no functioning first-party website), consistent with a dead/expired domain rather than a live site.

reviews_note: Verbatim quotes with real reviewer names pulled via WebFetch from reviews.birdeye.com/tno-painting-and-handyman-services-llc-156203833001459 (shows 4.8 stars / 48 reviews, a Birdeye-blended figure distinct from the 4.7/39 Google-specific figure used elsewhere on the site). Labeled on-site as 'Verified review' rather than 'Google review' since Birdeye aggregates multiple platforms and this build could not independently confirm each quote's exact source platform (unlike a case where Birdeye explicitly states a per-platform breakdown).

photos.source_note: gmaps_detail.js / gmaps_verify.js (run 3x) returned only 1 photo on the Google Maps listing. scripts/ig_photos.py successfully reached the real @tnopaintinghandyman Instagram via the Railway service but the account only exposed 1 public post, a selfie-style reel-cover graphic, unusable for the gallery. BBB, Angi and HomeAdvisor pages returned HTTP 403 to both WebFetch and curl and could not be scraped for photos. Facebook page/photos pages required login (blocked). Thumbtack's business profile page (thumbtack.com/fl/lakeland/interior-painting/tno-painting-handyman-service-llc/service/276359962343015620) returned HTTP 200 and exposed 10 real project photos in its page HTML (production-next-images-cdn.thumbtack.com), of which 4 were visually curated as usable after discarding: 1 blurry warehouse photo, 1 branded logo/profile card with baked-in text, and 4 generic reviewer-avatar placeholder icons. Combined with the single Google Maps photo, this gave 5 real, usable, curated photos (meets the pipeline's 5-photo minimum). One photo (patio table 'after' shot) was cropped to remove the photographer's visible shoes/legs at the bottom of the frame (POV curation rule); no content was invented or added.
